temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Passed capacity normalized independently over this branch; not absolute lithium fraction or full-cell SOC.

cell_link.evidence: Explicit source model and study; no common serialized specimen asserted across studies.

processing.selection: Lowest-rate complete main branch; initial short charge, remnant-capacity column and all higher-rate branches excluded.

limitations: Finite-current pseudo-OCP; polarization and branch hysteresis are retained, not a certified equilibrium OCP.
Same study/model does not establish identical half-cell/full-cell specimens.
Half-cell temperature not independently established; full-cell temperature settings are not transferred.
No independent electrochemical-model validation is claimed.
Paper names C/40; positive-electrode MAT rate field is 39. Both labels retained.
Column units are inferred from exact current-time charge integration and the documented voltage windows; no MAT column header is supplied.
